name: St. Michael
description: Grand Harbour tug, 20 m long, scuttled off Żonqor Point in Marsaskala in 1998 alongside Tug Boat 10. Upright on sand at 22 m, its top at about 17 m, a little away from the reef. Normally combined with Tug Boat 10 and the P33.
conditions: Expect less visibility here than at most Maltese sites.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
